name: reactivescript
description: ReactiveScript (.rx, .d.rx): highlighting, and TypeScript's types, hover, go to definition, completion and errors through the .rx language server, with the compiler's own diagnostics.

reactivescript.server.path.description: The language server's entry (bin/server.js of tooling/rx-language-server). Empty: the one beside this extension in the repository.

reactivescript.rxc.path.description: The rxc binary the server asks (compiler/target/release/rxc). Empty: the repository's release build.

reactivescript.typescript.tsdk.description: TypeScript's lib folder. Empty: the workspace's node_modules/typescript, else the one VS Code ships.
